card.name: Small words before 'the world' or global scope
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, on, around, anywhere, throughout, in) that sit right before a phrase about the world, other countries or a whole country. They appear in general web prose.

modes.label: Around/anywhere in the world
modes.description: A place word right before 'the world' in phrases about global spread.
modes.example: more than 50 fuel-cell-powered buses are currently in service<< around>> the world.

modes.label: Linking word before a scope phrase
modes.description: A preposition after a verb or adjective that leads into a broad or international reference.
modes.example: While very much in line<< with>> the participatory governance rhetoric

modes.label: Every/all before a country name
modes.description: A word following 'every' or 'all' that leads into a national or international setting.
modes.example: anti-BDS policies of every Jewish communal roof body<< in>> Australia

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning international, worldwide or global, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires on little words that are about to be followed by something like 'around the world' or 'worldwide'.
